title: parameter-type-too-wide ON by default, with an autofix
summary: parameter-type-too-wide ships ON as a warning in lint-all / lint-project and gets an autofix that retypes the parameter to the proved ancestor through the compile gate
intro: Read this when lint-all reports parameter-type-too-wide and you want to fix it, or want to know why a similar routine is not reported. The rule reports a class-typed parameter whose routine uses only members an ancestor declares; it skips library code, overrides and virtual methods, interface methods, published and form-bound event handlers and routines taken as a method pointer. The fix re-proves the finding, retypes both routine headers, adds the ancestor's unit to uses when needed, and with --compile-gate keeps the edit only when the project still builds.

questions.ask: Which parameters in my project could take a narrower type?
How do I narrow one reported parameter and keep the project building?
